verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is API-first: reading, search, file upload, output formats, presets, engine selection, cookies, locale, schema extraction and chunking are all exposed as `r.jina.ai`/`s.jina.ai` endpoints and `x-*` headers. The web 'code builder' UI just helps compose those same API parameters, so the UI offers nothing the API lacks. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of UI/API parity, a machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
